PCIMP.Name: Name
PCIMP.ClassHint: Import at level 1, or set a higher level to run every level's advancement now. Use Level Up on the sheet to grow the character later.
PCIMP.NoPacks: No classes, species or backgrounds were found. Make sure the D&D 5e system's content is available in this world.
PCIMP.ArrayInvalid: Use each Standard Array value exactly once.
PCIMP.FinalScores: These are final scores (overwrite after species/background bonuses)
PCIMP.AbilityHint: Enter base scores. Species (2014) or background (2024) increases are applied by the advancement step. Pasted scores are treated as final.
PCIMP.ExtrasHint: Only add extras here. Anything your species, background and class give is added automatically when the character is created.
PCIMP.MixedRules: Your picks mix 2014 and 2024 content. That works, but each item follows its own rules.
PCIMP.WillPlaceholder: not found — a placeholder will be created
PCIMP.ReviewHint: Create opens each advancement window in turn (hit points, ability increases, skill and feat choices, subclass, spells), the same as dropping the item on the sheet.
PCIMP.Failed: PC import failed. See the console (F12) for details.
PCIMP.ReportIntro: The character was created. These parts need a look:
PCIMP.ASIPossible: Ability Score Improvement or feat at a level in this range
PCIMP.LevelUpHint: The advancement window walks through hit points, new features and any choices for each level.
PCIMP.ClassMax: A class can't go above level 20.

placeholders.name: Create placeholders for unknown items
placeholders.hint: When an item, feat or spell from a pasted sheet isn't in any compendium, add a blank item with that name so nothing is lost.

playerImport.name: Players can import
playerImport.hint: Show the Import PC button to players who have permission to create actors.

levelUpButton.name: Level Up button
levelUpButton.hint: Show a Level Up button next to the rest buttons on character sheets.

PCIMP.EmptyTitle: No classes, species or backgrounds were found.
PCIMP.EmptyHint: The importer reads the D&D 5e system's built-in SRD compendiums (Classes, Races, Backgrounds, Character Classes, Character Origins). Check they appear in the Compendium sidebar, then press Reload lists.
PCIMP.EmptyStats: Compendiums read / Item compendiums · entries · entries without a type

Pick.species: Pick a species to see its traits.
Pick.background: Pick a background to see what it grants.
Pick.class: Pick a class to see its features.
Pick.subclass: Pick a subclass, or choose it later when the class asks for it.

PCIMP.SubclassLockedHint: Raise the level above to pick a subclass now, or leave it — the level-up that grants it will ask.
PCIMP.ArraySwapHint: Pick a value — the ability that had it swaps with this one.
PCIMP.SkillHint: Click once for proficient, twice for expertise, again to clear.
PCIMP.TypeToAdd: Type to search, Enter to add
PCIMP.ChooseLaterHint: The class asks for it when you reach that level

Pdf.Drop: Drop a character sheet PDF here
Pdf.Hint: Fillable sheets (the official 5e sheet, D&D Beyond exports) and text PDFs work. A .txt file works too.
Pdf.ReadForm: Read {file} ({pages} page(s), from the sheet's form fields). Check the text below — you can edit it and press Read sheet again.
Pdf.ReadText: Read {file} ({pages} page(s), from its text). Check the text below — you can edit it and press Read sheet again.
Pdf.Empty: That PDF has no readable text or form fields — it may be a scan or a photo. Type or paste the details instead.
Pdf.WrongType: Choose a PDF or a .txt file.
Pdf.Failed: Couldn't read {file}. Check the console (F12) for details.

PCIMP.Ambiguous: "{name}" could be {options} — pick one on the {step} step.
